issue.title: Updates-tab jump-hint allocation takes hundreds of ms in the All scope at a 2,000-row catalog
issue.description:
PROPOSED BY phase bead sase-w0.2 ("One list, domain sections, and the scope filter",
epic sase-w0, plan 202609/unified_updates_tab_1.md) as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP, routed
to a task by sase-w0.land on 2026-09-04.

Pressing `'` (entry jump) on the Admin Center Updates tab in the `All` scope with a
2,000-plugin catalog takes hundreds of milliseconds before the jump hints appear.
The gated per-keystroke metrics are unaffected — the scale bench's filter and
j-press p95 stay under the 16 ms budget at n=2000 — but jump-hint allocation has no
perf gate, so nothing bounds it. Measured during sase-w0.2 verification (2026-09-03)
and not caused by the merge: the pre-merge Plugins sub-tab drove the same jump
machinery over the same 2,000-row list.

Undiagnosed root-cause candidates: `_jump_repaint` funnels through a full
`_rebuild_options()` over all 2,000 OptionList rows to paint the `[hint]` prefixes
(src/sase/ace/tui/modals/plugins_browser_jump.py), and/or hint-map construction in
`build_jump_hint_maps` (src/sase/ace/tui/actions/navigation/jump_hints.py). Fix
should add a measurement first (SASE_TUI_PERF=1 writes per-keystroke JSONL), then
either patch hint prefixes in place via `replace_option_prompt_at_index` instead of
rebuilding, or bound/gate the allocation path; consider extending
tests/ace/tui/bench_plugins_catalog_scale.py to gate the `'` press.

Related, not duplicate: sase-us migrates four private selector alphabets onto the
shared jump-hint allocator — same root file, different remediation; a fix here could
collide with that migration.

task_type_fields.impact: A visible stall on ' in the All scope at large catalogs; worst-case scope only, gated p95 metrics unaffected.
task_type_fields.repro: Open the Admin Center Updates tab with the 2,000-plugin scale-bench catalog (tests/ace/tui/bench_plugins_catalog_scale.py fixture), cycle to the All scope with ], press '. Hint allocation takes hundreds of ms before hints render; SASE_TUI_PERF=1 JSONL confirms the stall is not on the gated filter/j-press paths.
